title: Row-list state invariant
statement: Let $Q,K$ be natural numbers. A state consisting of a list $R$ of rows of natural numbers and natural numbers $d,m,rc$ satisfies the invariant if $R$ has length $m$, that length is at most $K$, each row has length at most $K$, every entry of every row is less than $Q$, $d<Q$, and $rc\le m$.
